essence: Cellular-first decision substrate: typed decision-surface cells, delta hooks with deadband floors, per-cell append-only bookkeeper, exact Q16 rationals.

ideas.name: Identity never floats
ideas.statement: A cell is identified by integer quilt coordinates (k, s) plus declared type; values that are identities use the exact Q16 rational codec (num:int64, den:int64, always coprime) and floats are display-only projections — from_float refuses anything not representable rather than silently rounding.

ideas.name: Hooks eat deltas, not values
ideas.statement: A cell subscribes to a sibling's CHANGE (never a polled value): deltas below the hook's deadband floor are silent, a when-predicate can decline deltas whose shape isn't the hook's, and a broken predicate must never silence the fabric — every wake or silence is logged as a WakeResult.

ideas.name: Decide in one pass, project elsewhere; viability is binary
ideas.statement: The decider never renders and the renderer never decides (Law 3): a decision passes a binary confidence floor before it may project (Law 5); below the floor the outcome is booked as REJECTED, never projected, and a predictor pre-commits its feeling so the receipt binds feeling and fact in one hash.

ideas.name: Every state change is booked (replay = live)
ideas.statement: Each cell carries an append-only WAL of hash-chained receipts; wake = replay the book first, then decide; receipts are fnv1a-64 over UTF-8 bytes so a Rust receipt and a Python receipt for the same residue agree, decision-bearing fields are typed and uncapped (G20a), and book() raises rather than rounds what it cannot carry exactly.

ideas.name: Exactness-first backend ladder
ideas.statement: Backends resolve auto -> q16 (deterministic, always available) -> openjev-local -> typesafe-api (only if a key exists): cloud is last, exactness is first; cells without bookkeeping still decide but honestly forget (NullBookkeeper).

parts.name: cell identity law
parts.essence: coord must be a tuple of two integers (k, s); anything else raises TypeError at construction — identity never floats (Law 1).
parts.gate: non-integer or non-pair coord is refused at __post_init__
parts.failure_mode: a float coordinate would silently create an unfoundable identity

parts.name: Hook subscription primitive
parts.essence: A frozen Hook names a source cell, fires on delta, carries a DEADBAND token or a Q16 magnitude floor, and an optional when-predicate on the emitted state (the touch-shallow gate).

parts.name: Projection declaration
parts.essence: Outputs are declared edges (to, as_type): json | coefficient | choice | bytes — this cell renders, another cell decides; types are declared at the edge (Law 3).
outputs: typed payload on a named surface

parts.name: binary viability floor
parts.essence: A decision may LINK/project only above the floor: default viability is confidence > 0.0; pure difference without viability collapses into dada noise (Law 5).
parts.gate: confidence is None -> viable; else confidence > 0.0 required
parts.failure_mode: below-floor decisions are booked as REJECTED, never projected

parts.name: Q16 exact rational
parts.essence: Identity arithmetic on (num, den): always reduced coprime, negative denominators normalized, zero denominator raises — the same codec as the fleet's lattice kernel.
parts.gate: den == 0 raises ZeroDivisionError; gcd reduction is an invariant

parts.name: from_float projection refusal
parts.essence: Projection INTO the lattice: a float becomes Q16 only if num/SCALE reproduces it within 1e-12; anything else is refused — never silently rounded identity.
parts.failure_mode: silent rounding would corrupt every downstream exact decision

parts.name: deadband floor check
parts.essence: A hook wakes only if |delta| >= floor; the DEADBAND token or None floor means no filtering; magnitudes are exact Q16.

parts.name: unmeasurable deltas wake (honest default)
parts.essence: A delta with no extractable Q16 magnitude always wakes the hook — fail-open for unmeasurable shapes, the opposite of silently dropping what you can't measure.
parts.failure_mode: the named risk is noise amplification, accepted and receipted as the honest default

parts.name: emit fanout with logged silence
parts.essence: emit(source, delta, state) walks every hooked subscriber: below-floor/declining hooks are logged as WakeResult(woke=False, reason='silent_deadband'), others wake — silence is a recorded outcome, never an absence.
parts.gate: every hooked cell gets exactly one WakeResult per emit

parts.name: broken predicate fail-open
parts.essence: A when-predicate that raises must NOT silence the fabric: the exception is caught and the hook wakes — the failure direction is chosen explicitly.
parts.failure_mode: an exception inside a predicate silently starving cells is the named catastrophe

parts.name: wake = replay book, then decide
parts.essence: A cell woken by a delta first replays its bookkeeper (wake_state catch-up) before any decision — Law 4: replay equals live.
parts.failure_mode: deciding on a stale book would fork the cell from its own history

parts.name: predictor pre-commit (feeling under the ledger)
parts.essence: If the cell carries a predictor, it predicts BEFORE deciding, so the booked receipt binds feeling and fact in one hash — JEPA's slot, v0 the exact MeanPredictor.
parts.gate: predictor exception -> pred=None (feeling is optional, never fatal)

parts.name: backend resolution ladder
parts.essence: resolve_backend maps auto -> q16 (always available) -> openjev-local (if reachable) -> typesafe-api (if TYPESAFE_API_KEY): exactness first, cloud last.
parts.gate: unknown backend refused at Cell construction

parts.name: Bookkeeper append-only WAL
parts.essence: Per-cell append-only log of Receipt(tick, state_hash, delta_hash, decision_kind, payload_hash, payload) — the memory is the book; registration wires one per cell (or the honest NullBookkeeper).

parts.name: fnv1a-64 over UTF-8 bytes
parts.essence: The shared hash: raw BYTES (never str iteration/ord()) so a Rust receipt and a Python receipt for the same residue agree, non-ASCII included — the same algorithm as the rate limiter, hermit WAL and Rust substrate.
parts.gate: cross-language agreement on identical residues (fnv1a reference-vector suite)
parts.failure_mode: hashing str directly would fork Python from Rust receipts

parts.name: receipt sha binds the residue text
parts.essence: sha() re-derives payload_hash from the retained payload when present, so editing the payload alone breaks replay; empty payload keeps the historical formula — back-compat pinned byte-for-byte.
parts.gate: payload edit without hash edit -> replay mismatch (tamper is loud)

parts.name: typed uncapped decision fields (G20a)
parts.essence: Decision-bearing identity (dispatch_id, runner, key, correct, base_verdict, answer) rides as real dataclass fields, never JSON, never sliced by the 200-char payload render budget — identity never floats even in the book.
outputs: \x1f-delimited canonical decision_bytes extending the sha preimage only when set
parts.gate: all-None fields -> empty bytes -> historical preimage byte-identical (additive pin change only)
parts.failure_mode: a render budget evicting a dispatch id would break routing accountability (the C9 fail-open class)

parts.name: book() refuses what it cannot carry exactly
parts.essence: A booking with a non-str/bool typed field, or a value containing the reserved \x1f delimiter, raises rather than silently rounds (Law 6 clause iii: booked = foldable).
parts.failure_mode: silent rounding of a decision field is exactly the fail-open class G20a closed

parts.name: NullBookkeeper honesty
parts.essence: Cells with bookkeeper=False still decide — they just forget: book() no-ops, replay() returns None, verify() returns True, wake_state reports zero booked ticks; forgetting is a declared mode, not a silent omission.
parts.gate: wake_state honestly reports booked_ticks: 0, chain: None
parts.failure_mode: a pretending bookkeeper (fake verify) would be worse than an empty one

parts.name: polyformal ports with honest verification labels
parts.essence: The five laws re-exist in Rust (exact Q16 with no float constructor, overflow = None refusal, fnv1a-chained bookkeeper — 13 cargo tests green per README), Mercury (chain_valid/2, labeled UNVERIFIED — no mmc) and Haskell (phantom-typed Lattice/Proj, UNVERIFIED — no ghc): one substrate, several tongues, each labeled with its actual verification status.
parts.gate: UNVERIFIED is printed where no toolchain ran — do not write counts, run the suites
parts.failure_mode: claiming unverified ports as tested would violate the house law

cells.expr: Q16(num, den) coprime; from_float refuses unrepresentable
Choice | Score | Noul in one pass
Projection(to, as_type) only if viable; else booked REJECTED
append Receipt(tick, state_hash, delta_hash, kind, payload_hash)
rebuild state from book on wake (replay == live)

layer_logic.0: The substrate is the typed cell: integer (k,s) identity plus declared semantics, with Q16 exact rationals as the only identity-carrying numbers.
layer_logic.1: The mechanism is the delta runtime: emit fans out to hooks, wakes replay their books, predictors pre-commit, decisions are computed in one pass.
layer_logic.2: The policy is the gates: deadband floors, the when-predicate, the binary viability floor, the exactness-first backend ladder, and raise-don't-round booking.
layer_logic.3: The interface is the Cell v0 schema (registry names, hooks, projections as typed edges) and the polyform ports (Rust verified, Mercury/Haskell honestly labeled UNVERIFIED).
layer_logic.4: The evidence is per-cell fnv1a-64 receipt chains whose sha binds the residue text and typed decision fields, replay-equals-live tests, a measured 249-test suite, and KNOWN_SKIPS as the registry of honest omissions.
